opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants

amount.raw: grants of £2,000, maximum, for discrete research projects lasting no more than six months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected PhD in a historical subject to a UK institution, normally resident in the UK, not in full-time permanent academic employment, and current members of the Royal Historical Society. Current doctoral students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Provides grants of up to £2,000 to support career-building research or activities post-PhD, enabling a discrete outcome such as an article or book proposal.

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD, undertaking doctoral research in African history. Projects must be clearly and predominantly historical in orientation with a specific chronological remit.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to historians who are current members of the Royal Historical Society, who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (within 5 years of completing a PhD).
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend conferences.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History. Not open to those who have completed their doctorate.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not conference support).

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants

amount.raw: grants of either £500 or £1,000 per grant

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected PhD in a historical subject, who are current members of the Royal Historical Society. Not open to postgraduate students or those more than five years beyond PhD submission.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to early career historians to undertake research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not conference support).

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship in the History of Scotland and the Scottish People
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows and Members of the Royal Historical Society at all career stages, from PhD research and beyond.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of up to £2,500 to undertake research on the history of Scotland and the Scottish people worldwide.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead organisers who are current Fellows or members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £1,000 enabling historians to come together to pursue projects of shared interest, including discussion of research topics, testing research ideas, developing teaching practices, and networking.
